summary: A senior U.S. official warns of a possible attack on Iran's underground Mount Al-Mul nuclear facility within 24 hours. The IDF confirms killing four Hamas operatives in Gaza, including a Nukhba force member and an October 7 invader, citing ceasefire violations. Lebanon's president announces a new round of Israeli-Lebanese talks on the 20th in Tampa with a military delegation demanding a halt to Israeli operations.
key_points: A senior U.S. official tells Global Eye the U.S. may strike Iran's underground Mount Al-Mul nuclear site within 24 hours. (Source: @yediotnews25/136375)

IDF strikes kill four Hamas operatives in Gaza, including a Nukhba member who fired anti-tank missiles, a sniper, an October 7 invader, and another operative; the military says they violated the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59366)

Lebanese President Joseph Aoun announces the next Israeli-Lebanese talks will occur on the 20th in Tampa, Florida, with a Lebanese military delegation demanding an end to Israeli operations. (Source: @yediotnews25/136383)

Masked Israeli settlers attack European diplomats near Taybeh in the West Bank, injuring a French mayor and smashing a Belgian consulate vehicle; Israeli police open an investigation. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8483)

Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claims forces downed a Saudi Apache helicopter south of Najran; the Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles toward Khamis Mushait. (Source: @yediotnews25/136379, @N12chat/230458)
Iraqi Prime Minister orders an investigation into an ammunition cache explosion at an IRGC-backed PMU/Hashed Al Sha'abi site in eastern Baghdad; no casualties reported. (Source: @shin_persian/11223)
Daily Lebanon alert data shows 74 total alerts, 12 drone sightings, 31 artillery shelling incidents across 16 villages, and three airstrikes in Bani Haiyan and Qantara. (Source: @redlinkleb/48365)
Bushehr naval forces ordered evacuation and heightened readiness; a Mi-171E helicopter refueled at a base in Ziba Shahr, Fars Province. (Source: @shin_persian/11212, @shin_persian/11213)

points: A senior U.S. official tells Global Eye that the United States may attack Iran's underground nuclear facility at Mount Al-Mul (Mount of the Pickaxe) within the next 24 hours, signaling a potential major escalation. (Source: @yediotnews25/136375)
Two blasts were reported in the Strait of Hormuz, with delayed posts indicating explosions heard in the strategic waterway off Iran's coast. (Source: @shin_persian/11209, @shin_persian/11215)
Bushehr naval forces have been ordered to evacuate and increase readiness to a heightened alert level in Bushehr Province, home to Iran's nuclear power plant. (Source: @shin_persian/11212)

An Mi-171E helicopter conducted refueling operations at a base in Ziba Shahr, Fars Province, at coordinates 29.66953, 52.574077, indicating ongoing Iranian military aviation activity. (Source: @shin_persian/11213)

Masked Israeli settlers attacked a delegation of French, Belgian, and Polish diplomats, including Belgium's consul general, near Taybeh in the West Bank, injuring the mayor of Aulnoye-Aymeries and smashing a Belgian consulate vehicle window; Israeli police opened an investigation. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8483)

U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee condemned the attack on a journalist as terrorism and demanded the perpetrator be imprisoned for years, signaling strong U.S. diplomatic pressure. (Source: @amitsegal/65884)

IDF spokesperson stated the attackers were Jews who rioted, while Prime Minister Netanyahu said there was no evidence of this, highlighting a discrepancy in official accounts. (Source: @amitsegal/65879)
U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio expressed concern over images of settler violence in the West Bank, reflecting growing international scrutiny. (Source: @N12chat/230460)

The IDF announced the killing of four Hamas operatives in Gaza: Mahmoud Khaled Mohammed Madhoun (Nukhba Force, anti-tank missile attacks), Ubaida Suhail Hamad Murtaja (sniper), Adham Khalil Mohammed Marouf (October 7 invader), and Abd al-Jawad Juda; all were said to be advancing attacks and violating the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59366)
Israeli settlers attacked European diplomats near Taybeh in the West Bank, causing injuries and property damage, with Israeli police investigating. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8483)

IDF strikes in Gaza killed four Hamas operatives, including a Nukhba force member who conducted anti-tank missile attacks, a sniper, an October 7 invader, and another operative; the military stated they were systematically violating the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59366)
The IDF emphasized that the targeted operatives had recently advanced attacks on troops and Israeli civilians and attempted to restore Hamas capabilities. (Source: @manniefabian/59366)

Lebanese President Joseph Aoun announced the next round of talks with Israel will take place on the 20th of the month in Tampa, Florida, with Beirut sending a military delegation to demand a halt to Israeli operations and escalation. (Source: @yediotnews25/136383)

Artillery shelling struck Zoutar Al-Sharqiya, with the Israeli army also dropping a sound bomb on a house and conducting a combing operation in the town. (Source: @redlinkleb/48292, @redlinkleb/48318, @redlinkleb/48355)

Daily monitoring recorded 74 total alerts, 12 drone sightings (most in Meifdon with 3, Barashit 2, Nabatieh 2, Shoukin 2, Zbedin 2), and highest district activity in Nabatieh (27), Bint Jbeil (21), Marjayoun (13). (Source: @redlinkleb/48365)

Airstrikes hit Bani Haiyan (2) and Qantara (1); artillery shelling recorded 31 incidents across 16 villages including Zoutar Al-Sharqiya (6), Mansouri (5), Aita Al-Jabal Al-Zat (3), Meifdon (3), Wadi Al-Salouqi (2), Hadatha (2), Barashit (2), and others with single strikes. (Source: @redlinkleb/48365)
Warplanes were active over southern Lebanon, per live mapping alerts. (Source: @redlinkleb/48324)

Iraqi Prime Minister ordered an investigation into an ammunition cache explosion at an IRGC-backed PMU/Hashed Al Sha'abi site in eastern Baghdad; the blast involved damaged ammunition and caused no casualties. (Source: @shin_persian/11223, @shin_persian/11221, @shin_persian/11220)

Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claimed forces shot down a Saudi Apache helicopter south of Najran while it attacked border positions; the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles fired toward Khamis Mushait. (Source: @yediotnews25/136379, @N12chat/230458)
The Saudi-led coalition reported conducting 53 attack sorties across Yemen in the past 24 hours, indicating sustained high-tempo air operations. (Source: @yediotnews25/136379)
UKMTO issued Warning 175-26 and 176-26 for maritime security in the region, reflecting ongoing threats to shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/11208, @shin_persian/11211)
Faytuks Network weekly recap noted missile attacks in Saudi Arabia among other regional developments. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8484)

sections.threat_assessment: The potential U.S. strike on Iran's Mount Al-Mul nuclear facility represents the most immediate strategic escalation risk, which could trigger Iranian retaliation across the region. Simultaneously, the IDF's targeted killings of senior Hamas operatives in Gaza signal a lowering of the threshold for kinetic action despite the ceasefire, while intensified Israeli artillery and airstrikes in southern Lebanon suggest a pressure campaign ahead of diplomatic talks. Houthi claims of downing a Saudi Apache and continued missile launches indicate persistent capability to threaten Saudi air defenses and energy infrastructure. The Iraqi investigation into an IRGC-backed militia explosion highlights ongoing instability in Iranian proxy networks. These concurrent flashpoints create a high probability of miscalculation or deliberate escalation within days.
sections.regional_response: The United States is signaling both diplomatic pressure on Israel over settler violence and military readiness against Iran, with Ambassador Huckabee's terrorism designation and Secretary Rubio's concern contrasting with the reported strike planning. Lebanon is pursuing a diplomatic track via the Tampa talks while absorbing heavy bombardment, attempting to leverage a military delegation for concessions. Saudi Arabia maintains active air operations in Yemen and missile defenses, demonstrating resolve against Houthi escalation. Iraq's investigation into the PMU site reflects Baghdad's attempt to manage Iranian-backed militia activities without direct confrontation. European nations affected by the settler attack may demand stronger accountability measures from Israel.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 24-hour timeline for a potential U.S. strike on Mount Al-Mul requires monitoring of U.S. force posture in the Gulf, including B-2 deployments and tanker movements. The IDF's disclosure of specific Hamas operative names and roles (Nukhba, sniper, October 7 invader) suggests precise intelligence and a deliberate messaging strategy to justify ceasefire enforcement. The granular Lebanese artillery data (31 strikes, village-level breakdown) indicates robust monitoring by redalert.com.lb and likely Israeli targeting of Hezbollah infrastructure in the Nabatieh-Bint Jbeil corridor. The dual UKMTO warnings and Strait of Hormuz blasts warrant scrutiny of maritime traffic patterns and Iranian naval readiness at Bushehr. The Iraqi PM's investigation order may precede action against specific PMU factions, affecting Iran's land corridor to Syria.
